d: The Thunder defeated the Pelicans, 126-120 tonight in Oklahoma City. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander contributed a team-high 40 points to go with 8 assists 4 three pointers and 3 rebounds, with Aday Mara of the Thunder adding an additional 22 points (11-15 FG) in the game. Zion Williamson finished with a team-high 22 points along with 7 assists for the Pelicans in the losing effort. The Thunder improve their record to 10-6 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 5-12 for the season.
